lines.t: I grew up in the crossfire,
Learned to bleed and call it pride.
Wore my trauma like an armor,
Swore I’d never let You inside.Blamed the world for all my damage,
Cursed the sky for every scar.
Used the pain just like a weapon,
Kept it loaded in my heart.
But every time I raise my fist,
I can feel You closing in.
Like a storm behind my rib cage,
Tearing down the walls I’m in.
You’re a wildfire in my bones,
Breaking down my alibis.
Jealous love that won’t let go,
Hunting down my perfect lies.
Take the wounds, take the sin,
Every war I start within.
If I fight, You burn straight through—
I can’t outrun a God like You.
I’ve been hiding in religion,
Playing victim, talking tough.
Pointing fingers at the villains,
Never saying I’ve had enough.I’ve been drunk on my excuses,
Calling bitterness my shield.
But Your anger at my darkness
Is the fire that makes me kneel.
Every secret that I bury
Starts to shake when You draw near.
You don’t whisper, You come roaring,
Calling out what I won’t hear.
You’re a wildfire in my bones,
Breaking down my alibis.
Jealous love that won’t let go,
Hunting down my perfect lies.
Take the wounds, take the sin,
Every war I start within.
If I fight, You burn straight through—
I can’t outrun a God like You.
Set my idols all on fire,
Let the smoke choke out my pride.
If I burn, then let it be
Every lie I’ve lived inside.
Heal the boy they tried to break,
Judge the man I chose to be.
If it takes a holy war,
Light the match and come for me.
You’re a wildfire in my bones,
Crashing through my last defense.
Jealous love that shakes the throne
Of every false innocence.
Take the wounds, take the sin,
Drag the darkness out of them.
If I run, You tear right through—
I was made to be claimed by You.
